theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Leader with highest score (1.655) and eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Durability bar (0.5) is mid-range and breadth (0.556) is only moderate, so this is trend-following on a legitimate, gate-cleared leader, not a high-conviction call. Hurst tag mean-revert suggests the move may be choppy rather than persistent, and the crowded flag is false.
evidence: backtest_verdict: gate_helps true (trend discipline validated as risk control)
theses.dissent: Hurst mean-revert and breadth only 0.556 indicate the leadership is not strongly trending; a mean-reversion pullback in the leader is plausible. Track record directional accuracy of 35% says even a correct topic call is often wrong on direction.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers

theses.dissent: Rotation margin to the leader is razor-thin (0.11) and low overall absorption (0.3) means leadership may flip quickly; energy is highly sensitive to macro/oil-price shocks that the theme detector cannot time.
